task: write code for Jira ticket MPS-2

outcome.summary: Implemented MPS-2 (Mall Parking System vehicle entry/ticketing) as a new self-contained parking/ module: an entry service that issues unique OPEN parking tickets with normalized vehicle number and server-generated entry time, rejects entry when the lot is full (LOT_FULL), and is idempotent under a client-supplied idempotency key. Added CLI (python -m parking.app --capacity N), config slice with validated capacity, and 20 unit tests. Full suite passes: 41 pytest, 20 unittest, plus CLI smoke. Existing mps/ module left untouched.

decisions.decision: Build MPS-2 as a new self-contained parking/ module instead of extending the existing mps/ package.
decisions.reason: The in-repo Jira/Confluence fixtures describe a Mall Parking System, while mps/ is a Master Production Schedule planning engine; current repo sources override stale memory that misread the MPS acronym.

decisions.decision: Leave the existing mps/ module untouched.
decisions.reason: It is an unrelated Master Production Schedule artifact; retiring or rewriting it is a separate decision out of scope for MPS-2.

decisions.decision: Include a minimal MPS-1 configuration slice (ParkingConfiguration with validated capacity and ConfigStore.active()) inside the parking module.
decisions.reason: MPS-2 depends on MPS-1; capacity is needed for the lot-full check, and placeholder fields (grace/rates/currency/version) leave a clean seam for MPS-3/4/6.

decisions.decision: Provide a CLI only (python -m parking.app --capacity N), not FastAPI endpoints.
decisions.reason: Repo convention from MPS-1 is CLI-based; FastAPI was available but not required by MPS-2 acceptance criteria.

decisions.decision: Treat in-repo jira/ and confluence/ files as the authoritative requirements source rather than ~/Downloads/jira_tickets.json.
decisions.reason: A prior MPS-2 episode failed during planning trying to read the external file; the authoritative tickets live in the repository.

decisions.decision: Keep ticket creation and occupancy increment atomic in TicketService.enter() (idempotency check, then capacity check, then insert plus increment).
decisions.reason: Confluence business rule requires ticket creation and occupancy increment to be atomic, and acceptance criteria require occupancy to change exactly once per accepted entry.

artifacts.purpose: Package marker exporting ParkingConfiguration, create_ticket, get_ticket, LotFullError, ParkingTicket, TicketService, and STATUS_OPEN
App package marker exporting config and ticket-service classes
ParkingConfiguration (validated capacity >= 1; MPS-1 placeholder fields) and ConfigStore.active()
Core MPS-2 engine: normalize_vehicle_number, ParkingTicket, TicketStore, Occupancy, TicketService.enter()/.get(), LotFullError
CLI accepting single or batch JSON requests and emitting ticket JSON or LOT_FULL error
20 unit tests covering all four acceptance criteria, normalization, injectable server clock, atomicity, and CLI behavior
Authoritative MPS-2 ticket requirements and acceptance criteria
MPS-1 dependency context for capacity/fee configuration
Entry flow, business rules, and suggested API for vehicle entry
Existing MPS-1 CLI conventions to mirror for the parking CLI
Existing MPS-1 unittest conventions to mirror for parking tests
Prior failed MPS-2 episode; learned authoritative tickets live in jira/, not the external Downloads path

observations: 41 passed in 0.06s: 21 baseline (episodic-memory plus MPS-1) plus 20 new parking tests
Single request returned OPEN ticket JSON with normalized vehicle number
Batch of three requests at capacity 2 returned LOT_FULL for the third entry
Package imports (parking.create_ticket, get_ticket, ParkingConfiguration, LotFullError) succeeded

reusable_knowledge: In-repo fixtures are authoritative: jira/MPS-*.json and confluence/CONF-MPS-*.json describe a Mall Parking System and override stale episodic memory that decoded MPS as Master Production Schedule.
Do not read external ticket files (e.g., ~/Downloads/jira_tickets.json) for MPS work; the prior MPS-2 episode failed in planning doing this. Authoritative tickets live under jira/ in the repository.

MPS-2 entry-service design pattern: one transaction boundary in TicketService.enter() (idempotency-key check first, then capacity check, then ticket insert plus occupancy increment) satisfies uniqueness, exactly-once occupancy, LOT_FULL, and idempotency acceptance criteria.
Normalize vehicle numbers by trim+uppercase and reject blank/non-string values; generate entry_time server-side with an injectable clock for deterministic tests.

Repo conventions to reuse: module layout (core + app/main.py CLI + tests), python -m <module>.app invocation, JSON input from stdin/file, errors to stderr with exit code 2, and unittest discover for module tests (pytest collects all).
Money/config values are stored as integer paise (INR) in ParkingConfiguration placeholder fields, providing the seam for MPS-3 fee calculation.
